taxpayer_name.rationale: No canonical element for taxpayer name exists in the candidate list; the form header name field is not represented as a standalone XSD element in IRS4562.

taxpayer_identifying_number.rationale: No canonical element for the identifying number (SSN/EIN) exists in the candidate list; the form header EIN/SSN field is not represented as a standalone XSD element in IRS4562.

business_activity.rationale: BusinessOrActivityTxt matches the form header 'Business or activity to which this form relates' field exactly.

amortization_items.rationale: AmortizationInfoTable is the repeating table element under AmortizationInfo that holds each row of Part VI Line 42 amortizable cost entries; the blueprint array maps to this repeating group rather than any single leaf element.

line_43_amortization_prior_years.rationale: AmortizationCostsBeforeTYAmt corresponds to Line 43 — amortization of costs that began before the current tax year.

line_44_total_amortization.rationale: TotalAmortizationAmt corresponds to Line 44 — total amortization, the sum of current-year column (f) amounts and Line 43.
